subject: Isolated Site Image Transfer and Signing Protocol
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-financial.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Isolated Site Image Transfer and Signing Protocol

Evelyn / team,

Thanks for taking this on. We're scheduled to receive the signed images and transfer instructions for our air-gapped facility next week (maintenance window is 2026-12-27). Before the transfer we need to confirm a few things for our security/compliance team:

- Exact checksum and signature verification steps we should run offline.
- Manifest format (we need a machine-readable CSV for inventory).
- Authorized transport methods (sneakernet media vs. secure courier) and acceptance criteria.
- A dry-run process so we can validate signatures without applying images to production.

Can you provide the transfer manifest and a compact runbook we can hand to our on-site Ops? Also confirm who will countersign at Redwood for chain-of-custody.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
IT Operations, Acme Financial
[Attachment: airgap-requirements-acme.pdf (pdf)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-financial.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T10:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Site Image Transfer and Signing Protocol

Sam — thanks for the clear checklist. We can cover everything you listed. High-level plan below; I'll attach the manifest and checklist after Dev signs off.

High-level: 
1) Build & sign: Redwood build pipeline produces docker/base VM image + tar bundle. We create an accompanying .sig (Ed25519) and checksum (sha256).
2) Manifest: CSV with fields: filename, sha256, size_bytes, signature_file, build_id, build_time, signer_email. Machine-readable and human-readable cover sheet included.
3) Transfer: We support both encrypted USB drive (AES-256, LUKS) and courier-signed sealed container. Transfer manifest will include transport method, seal ID, and courier tracking.
4) Verification steps (dry-run):
   - Import public signing key (redwood_pub_v2.pem) into an offline verifier.
   - Verify signature: ed25519 verify <bundle> <bundle.sig> using redwood_pub_v2.pem.
   - Compare sha256sum against manifest.
   - For VMs: mount image in a sandbox host and validate binary versions listed in manifest.
5) Chain-of-custody: Redwood will provide signed transfer manifest + a countersign PDF. Primary signer: Dev Patel (build lead). Secondary countersign: Laura Bennett (security ops).

I will attach the draft manifest and our airgap checklist in the next note after Dev gives final OK.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none in this message]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-financial.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Site Image Transfer and Signing Protocol

Eve / Sam — I reviewed the build artifacts and ran a local verification pass. Notes below and attached artifacts.

Quick notes:
- Signatures: we use Ed25519 with timestamped signature metadata (RFC-style header with build_id). The .sig file is detached; verification command examples are in transfer-instructions-ACME-20261220.docx.
- Public key: redwood_pub_v2.pem (fingerprint: 3f:9b:...:a2). We'll include this as a separate file on the manifest (do not combine into the bundle).
- Manifest: attached CSV (airgap-transfer-manifest-ACME-20261220.csv). Confirmed sha256 for all files.
- Dry-run: provide a minimal verification script (bash) that runs offline; it returns exit codes suitable for automation (0 = all good, 2 = signature fail, 3 = checksum mismatch).

Attachments included:
- redwood-signed-bundle-v2.1.tar.sig (signature file)
- airgap-transfer-manifest-ACME-20261220.csv
- airgap-checklist-v1.0.pdf
- transfer-instructions-ACME-20261220.docx

Please confirm if you want the public key on a separate OTP-protected USB or included in the sealed transfer. My preference is separate token plus manifest entry.

--
Dev Patel
Build Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-signed-bundle-v2.1.tar.sig (signature)]

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-financial.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-21T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Site Image Transfer and Signing Protocol

Dev / team — thanks, this is what we needed. A couple of clarifications before we schedule the courier: 

- For the public key: we'll require the key to arrive on a separate sealed token (USB+PIN) and the token seal ID must be recorded in the manifest.
- Dry-run: can you confirm the verification script does NOT attempt to mount or modify images by default? Ops wants a read-only mode.
- Acceptance criteria: if the signature and checksum validate, our on-site lead will countersign the manifest and send a signed acceptance PDF to you.

If you can update the manifest to include the token seal ID and a short read-only verification flag, we can confirm the courier booking for 2026-12-26 (arrive 12/27).

Sam
IT Operations, Acme Financial
[Attachment: none]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@acme-financial.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-22T14:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Isolated Site Image Transfer and Signing Protocol

Sam — updated per your requests. Summary of changes in the attached manifest & instructions: 

- "token_seal_id" column added to manifest; redwood will populate before handoff.
- The verification script has a --read-only / --dry-run flag; default is dry-run. Commands in transfer-instructions-ACME-20261220.docx show examples.
- Countersign flow: On successful verification, Acme's on-site lead signs the manifest (PDF) and uploads to the DocuSign envelope (link below). Redwood will countersign and return an archived copy.

Next steps: 
- Dev: please finalize and embed the token_seal_id in the manifest and re-upload to Drive.
- Sam: confirm courier method (encrypted USB vs. sealed courier) and final delivery window.
- Marissa: I'll loop you in for the billable transfer fee and procurement (quote on courier included).

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/secure/ACME-transfer-DL-2026-ACME-47
Drive manifest: https://drive.redwood.com/share/airgap/ACME/transfer-manifest-20261220
Jira: RDW-8923 (airgap handoff)

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Deployments
Redwood Inference
